terms.comment: Our playful third-declension adaptation of the Japanese name, not an established Latin form. Genitive Totorōnis; dative Totorōnī; accusative Totorōnem; ablative Totorōne; vocative Totorō. The long final -ō in the nominative and vocative is part of our chosen Latin declension. The remaining name vowels follow our local reading convention.

phrases.english: He walks through the forest with Totoro.
Totoro’s house is in the forest.

sources: The grouped card gave no source: the name is our own adaptation.
